[Am7b5]

[Verse 1]
[Am7b5]If you take too long to hit me back
[Fdim]I can't promise you how I'll react But
[Eb]all I can say is
[Eb7]at least I'll wait for you
[Am7b5]Lately, I've been on a roller coaster
[Fdim]Tryna get a hold of my emotions But
[Eb]all that I know is
[Eb7]I need you close And I'ma scream and shout for what

[Pre-Chorus]
[Am7b5]I love Passionate, but I don't give
[Fdim]no fucks I admit that I'm a lil'
[Eb]messed up But I can hide it when I'm all
[Eb7]dressed up I'm obsessive and I love
[Am7b5]too hard Good at overthinking with
[Fdim]my heart How you even think it got
[Eb]this far, this far?
[Eb7]And I can be needy,

[Chorus]
[Am7b5]way too damn needy
[Fdim]I can be needy,
[Eb]tell me how
[Eb7]good it feels to be needed
[Am7b5]I can be needy,
[Fdim]so hard to please me
[Eb]I know it
[Eb7]feels so good to be needed

[Verse 2]
[Am7b5]Sorry if I'm up and down a lot
[Fdim]Sorry that I think I'm not enough And
[Eb]sorry if I
[Eb7]say sorry way too much
[Am7b5]You can go ahead and call me selfish But
[Fdim]after all this damage, I can't help it But
[Eb]what you can trust is
[Eb7]I need your touch And I'ma scream and shout for what
